evidence.quote: PURPOSE:To improve the operating efficiency of manufacturing a thin film transistor by forming a metal film when forming source.drain electrodes, and then heat treating it prior to patterning to cause a boundary reaction between an ohmic contact layer and the metal film as a low resistance layer unnecessary for patterning the metal film.

PURPOSE:To form an insulating film which has an excellent boundary characteristic by keeping a glass substrate at a specific temperature or lower and at the same time depositing an insulating newer thereon and then applying heat treatment thereto in a specific range of temperature.

Provided are a piezoelectric film having high piezoelectric characteristics and a piezoelectric element provided with the piezoelectric film. In the piezoelectric film that includes a perovskite-type oxide represented by general formula P, 0.1≤x≤0.3 and 0<y≤0.49x are satisfied.
